## Cooshee (CR 2)

**XP 600  
** NG Medium magical beast  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +7  

**Defense**

  **AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +3 natural)  
 **hp** 36 (3d10+6)  
 **Fort** +5, **Ref** +6, **Will** +2; +4 vs. enchantment  

**Offense**

  **Speed** 40 ft. (plus sprint)  
 **Melee** Bite +6 (1d8+3 plus grab or trip), 2 claws +6 (1d4+2)  

**Statistics**

  **Str** 15, **Dex** 17, **Con** 15, **Int** 4, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 6  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6 (+10 to grapple); **CMD** 18  
 **Feats** Alertness, Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Perception +7, Sense Motive +3, Stealth +11 (+15*), Survival +5 (+9**); **Racial Modifiers** +4 Stealth *Due to their coloration, the racial bonus to Stealth checks increases to +8 in their natural environment. **Cooshee have a +4 racial bonus on Survival checks when tracking by scent.  
 **SQ** sprint  

**Special Abilities**

 **Sprint (Ex)** Once per hour, a cooshee can move ten times its normal speed (400 ft.) when it makes a charge attack.  

**Ecology**

 **Environment** temperate Forests  
 **Organization** solitary, pair, or pack (4–9)  
 **Treasure** none
